claude_proposed_widenings.name: ActivatedAbilityMechanics.range
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Activated magic items can have a range distinct from self. The Rod of Rulership targets creatures within 120 feet, but ActivatedAbilityMechanics has no range field. The tracer renders the target attachment as 'range Self', silently misrepresenting the 120-foot range.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: each creature of your choice that you can see within 120 feet of yourself
